name: Composite Alliance Group Inc.
summary: Composite Alliance Group Inc. engages in designing, manufacturing, and selling machines and processes to customers for fabricating composite materials. The company's services include engineering, automation and robotization, manufacturing optimization, prototyping, commission, and after-sales support. It also provides lay-up equipment, compaction/hot drape forming products, molds, molding presses, handling tools, and completion products. Composite Alliance Group Inc. is headquartered in Calgary, Canada.
